both files stood exactly at their baselines on develop. The image hash index was keyed by (size, whole-second mtime), so a same-size rewrite in the same second reused the previous picture's variant; the fix gives HashIndexEntry the stat record SourceMetadata already carries (FileStat, the full-stat lookup/update/carry_forward/resolve, and the doc for why the video path keeps lookup_whole_second) = +133 in cache.rs, and moves identity_disagrees next to stat_identity in types.rs (+8) so the watcher, the frontmatter scan cache and the index share one definition (two hand copies deleted from watch.rs and frontmatter_cache.rs). The change also deletes four hand-copied (size, whole-second mtime) extractions from image.rs, cas_heal.rs, parse_cache.rs and scan.rs. Not split out: moving HashIndex to its own module adds a 70th child to build/ (baseline 69) and carries ~250 lines of its tests with it, which is a relocation to do on its own, not inside a correctness fix.

cache.rs +21: HashIndex::resolve refuses to read a file that is still in the cloud (an Err before hash_file), split into resolve/resolve_with so a test can inject the hasher and the cloud predicate; the two-line guard is the fix, the rest is the seam signature and the doc saying why a provider re-materialisation makes the strict lookup miss. scan.rs +10: the evicted branch of extract_media_metadata_cached answers by the whole-second lookup again (it cannot hash) and never caches a non-answer under a hash; the growth is the comment that says why that is safe. Not split out: moving HashIndex to its own module adds a 70th child to build/ (baseline 69), a relocation to do on its own.

cache.rs +2: the carry_forward doc now says why the guard is load-bearing for images (the scan's evicted branch). image.rs +15 (2937 to 2952; the file already stood at 2944 on develop, 7 over, unaccepted): compute_image_item_fingerprint is split into a stat-taking half and image_item_fingerprint, which takes a stat record already in hand, so a test can hand the fingerprint a record that differs in one field (ctime cannot be set from userland). The split goes away when the fingerprint becomes a (FileStat, params) value.

cache.rs +27: HashIndex counts its own answers so a build can say what the index did (one info line, [cache] hash-index: N hits, M rehashed, printed once at the post-join point in await_completion). Two process-wide atomics, a count_hit wrapper on lookup and lookup_whole_second, one increment in update (every path that hashes for want of a hit records through it, so there is no per-caller increment to forget), and the report function; the reviewer of a930263 had to build probe binaries to count index hits. Not split out: moving HashIndex to its own module adds a 70th child to build/ (baseline 69), a relocation to do on its own.

image.rs +6 (2952 to 2958): the image worker takes the item's fingerprint before it reads the source and records it in its teardown for an item that delivered, where the dispatch used to record it before any worker had run (the desktop gate then vouched for sources a cancelled or cloud-deferred worker never encoded). Two small fns (matches / record) replace the one check-and-update. Expected to come back down when the fingerprint becomes a (FileStat, params) value.

media/image.rs: the dispatch's delivered-fingerprint map gains a pending marker beside it (ImageLedger, one lock, ~35 prod lines with docs) and a join branch, so a second dispatch before the worker ran joins it instead of spawning another; the three copies of the rung-URL derivation (worker, heal, dispatch) collapse into promised_rungs, which pays back about 30 of it

media/image.rs +15 (2989 to 3004): ImageConversionItem carries the fingerprint its dispatch took (a field and an ended() method that ends the dispatch's marker and records the delivery) so the worker no longer stats the source itself; the worker's stat call, its comment and the dispatch's separate queued vec are gone, and ending a marker is now compare-and-clear, which is the ownership rule the join needs
